evidence: The SOI 2025 layer has the same 8 Mizoram districts as the pre-2018 map (Aizawl, Champhai, Kolasib, Lawngtlai, Lunglei, Mamit, Saiha, Serchhip). Khawzawl (from Champhai) and Saitual (from Aizawl) are absent, though the events compilation dates both to 2019; Hnahthial is absent from the events compilation entirely, a gap in that source, not the map. Wikidata carries separate items for all three (Khawzawl Q86882591, Saitual Q86882593, Hnahthial Q86882590), each with distinct coordinates, confirming they are recognised as separate current entities, though Wikidata records no inception date for them. Unlike the Assam 1981 case, this is not a mislabelled vintage (the 2025 map is not secretly depicting some other single year): it is a real gap in SOI's latest boundary update for one state. lib.depicted_year is not used here because it must stay monotonic with the map's own vintage ordering (s11 CHECK depicted_year >= year; s09 window selection assumes d(a) < event_year <= d(b)), and Mizoram's 2021 vintage already shows Khawzawl and Saitual as separate CKs -- asserting the 2025 vintage depicts an earlier year would invert that ordering. This table exists instead of forcing the gap into vintage_depiction.csv. It explains, but does not silence, the 3 MERGED_INTO edges into the 2025 Champhai CK in s05 lineage (see CLAUDE.md Open items and outputs/pipeline/s05_district_relationship.csv).
